decision_rule.pass: actual session emit closure writes ordered typed_observation and observation rows byte-equivalently to events.jsonl and delivered.jsonl, preserving nested health/ammo values and integer emit_ns; source backend emits typed evidence before image publication and full observation
decision_rule.fail: any required row, nested value, order, file equality, timestamp type, or source ordering condition is false

scope: No live game, model, GUI, X11, input, Docker, GPU, or formal #59 allocation. The check exercises the exact session emit closure with synthetic representative records and statically checks the current typed-backend source order.
